content.title: Patriarch Ignatius Peter III: The Man Who Convened the Mulanthuruthy Synod
content.caption: Patriarch Ignatius Peter III, a key figure in the Malankara Church, was the Patriarch of Antioch and head of the Syriac Orthodox Church from 1872 until his death in 1894.

slides.heading: Patriarch Ignatius Peter III: The Man Who Convened the Mulanthuruthy
slides.text: Patriarch Ignatius Peter III, a key figure in the Malankara Church, was the Patriarch of Antioch and head of the Syriac Orthodox Church from 1872 until his death in 1894.

slides.heading: The Synod of Mulanthuruthy
slides.text: The Synod of Mulanthuruthy, held in 1876, was a significant event in the history of the Malankara Church, which was convened by Patriarch Ignatius Peter III.

slides.heading: The Canonization of Ignatius Peter III
slides.text: The Episcopal Synod of the Jacobite Syrian Church decided to complete the procedures to canonize Patriarch Ignatius Peter III, who convened the historic Mulanthuruthy Synod in 1876.
